about_the_game:
Insignis – A Speed and Strategy-Based Single-Player Board Game

Insignis is currently a single-player board game where the player competes to deliver magical gems to customers as quickly and efficiently as possible. Set in a world struck by economic crisis, wizards and merchants desperately need precious gems. The player must arrange the gems according to specific requirements, combine different abilities, and act faster than the game’s challenges to succeed.

Gameplay Mechanics

  • Quick Decision-Making and Gem Arrangement:
    The player must organize the gems based on given rules and fulfill customer requests as quickly as possible. Finding the right combinations requires both timing and attention.

  • Ability Usage and Combos:
    The player can use unique abilities to help arrange gems faster, make extra moves, or slow down the challenges. Strategic use of these abilities can completely change the course of the game.

  • Competing Against the Clock:
    The game operates under time pressure, with the player needing to manage time effectively to avoid losing customers.

  • Different Playstyles:
    Players can choose to play aggressively by making quick deliveries or focus on creating complex, high-value combinations for greater rewards. The game allows for diverse strategies, making each session unique.

Themes and Atmosphere

The world of Insignis is set in a time of economic turmoil, where wizards, alchemists, and merchants fiercely compete. The player must use their intelligence and reflexes to become the most successful trader in this chaotic era.

Winning Conditions

The game challenges the player to deliver the most gems to customers within a set time or by completing specific tasks to secure victory.

In the future, a multiplayer version is planned, allowing players to compete against each other in this fast-paced world.

  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
